- Private deployment (VPC) for production inference (customer data stays in their VPC).
- Need guidance on licensing model, support tiers, and environment count (prod/staging/dev).
- Core pricing sensitivity: looking for target $/1M tokens and overall budget range for first 12 months.

1) Current monthly token consumption (avg/month) and expected growth over 12 months (high/med/low).
2) Target budget range for inference (monthly or annual) you have for this project.
3) How many environments do you plan to run (prod, staging, sandbox, dev) and whether those need dedicated capacity / SLAs.
4) Any procurement constraints (PO process, contract length preference, required support tiers).

What I’ll do next:
- Put together a tailored pricing approach: one option with a platform license + per-1M token unit economics, and an alternative with reserved capacity pricing (dedicated GPUs + support).
- Share a short pricing deck and a draft MOU for procurement to review.

If you can send the numbers above (esp. token volumes and budget range), I’ll have a first-pass commercial to share by tomorrow EOD PT.

Ben / Marissa / Alex — thanks for the context. Quick first-pass commercial and unit economics based on 120M -> 1B tokens/mo ramp: 

High-level offer (two options):

Option A — Platform License + Unit Pricing (recommended for customers who want predictable unit economics and faster go-live)
- Platform license (annual): $120k/year (includes private control plane, base security integrations, audit logs).
- Unit pricing: Pilot tier (<=200M tokens/mo): $900 / 1M tokens.
- Scale tier (200M–1B tokens/mo): $650 / 1M tokens (volume tiers applied monthly).
- Overages: $750 / 1M tokens for incremental usage beyond committed thresholds.
- Support: Enterprise support add-on: $25k/month (24x7 coverage, 2-hr critical SLA, TAM). Standard support: included (business hours, 4-hr P1).
- Environments: Prod dedicated env is a one-time setup + monthly environment fee: $10k/month for dedicated prod capacity (covers reserved GPU pool sizing for SLA). Staging (shared burst): $3k/month. Sandbox/dev: free for best-effort (rate-limited).

Estimated economics for first 6 months (pilot at <=200M tokens/mo):
- Token cost: 200M tokens * $900/1M = $180k/month (note: exceeds stated pilot budget; recommend discount or reserved commit).

Option B — Reserved Capacity Pricing (recommended if FinTechCo prefers fixed cost and capacity isolation)
- Monthly reserved commit (example sizing for baseline 120M tokens -> ~1–2 p3-equivalent GPUs): $80k/month (includes reserved GPU nodes & platform license allocation).
- Support: Enterprise add-on $25k/month.
- Over-provision buffer: additional burst/sharing billed at $600 / 1M tokens when autoscale used beyond reserved capacity.
- Environments: Prod capacity baked into reserved commit. Additional staging capacity: $5k/month. Sandbox/dev: $1k/month.

Target $/1M tokens:
- Pilot effective target should be <= $600–800 / 1M tokens after negotiation/commit (to hit customer budget).
- At scale (>=200M tokens/mo), target $/1M tokens should approach $400–650 range depending on committed volume and term length.

Notes / caveats:
- KV cache / batching can reduce effective token billing for repeated prefixes; we can propose caching strategies to lower unit cost by ~15–30% for high-repetition workloads.
- Quantization/model choice impacts throughput and therefore unit pricing; using int8-quantized variants reduces GPU requirements and can move unit pricing toward the lower bound.
- SOC2 + audit logs are covered in the platform license; can provide formal attestations and evidence for procurement.

Next steps:
1) Ben: present Option A and B to Alex with a recommended path (we recommend Option A + a 6–12 month reserved discount to fit the pilot budget).
2) If Alex is comfortable, share a redlined MOU and target a commercial review next week.
3) Technical deep-dive to size exact GPU counts if they can share per-feature token breakout.

Happy to refine the numbers — ping me and I’ll run through a few committed-commit scenarios that meet the <$150k/month pilot constraint.

Thanks,
